records.title: 接入火山方舟（Ark, volces.com）报 400：pi-ai 将系统提示词以 developer 角色发出，方舟只接受 system/assistant/user/tool
records.body:
> Ark (volces.com) integration fails with 400 `InvalidParameter`: system prompt is sent with role `developer`, which the Ark gateway rejects

## 环境

- dsh：`0.1.0-rc.7`（当前 npm 最新版）
- 底层 LLM 客户端：`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `0.82.1`（dsh 内置；npm 最新 `0.84.2` 同样存在此问题）
- 接入方式：`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` → `llm-pi-ai.providers` 自定义提供方，协议 `api: openai-completions`

## 现象：本次遇到的每一个错误

配置了两个火山方舟提供方（Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan），模型为 DeepSeek V4（GLM 等声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型同样受影响）：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    ark-agent:
      displayName: Ark Agent
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_AGENT_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash
          reasoningEfforts: { off: "", high: high, max: max }
        # ... deepseek-v4-pro 同
    ark-code:
      displayName: Ark Code
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_CODE_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3
      models:
        # 同样声明了 reasoningEfforts
```

### 错误 1：ark-agent（`/api/plan/v3`）

每次调用直接失败：

```
本轮运行失败400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 0217871311856159ee13f605c3786670e0524dbc441cb77696edd","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

### 错误 2：ark-code（`/api/coding/v3`）

完全相同的错误（不同 request id）：

```
本轮运行失败400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 02178713365052253d6ccd6c87f6638f3cd2525e8826483913bc8","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

### 最小复现（curl，与 DSH 无直接关系，用于证明端点行为）

两个端点行为一致：

| 请求 role | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `developer` | ❌ 400 `InvalidParameter: invalid value: developer` |
| `system` | ✅ 200，正常返回（deepseek-v4-flash 默认还会输出 `reasoning_content`） |

## 根因与错误代码定位

系统提示词（system prompt）被以 `developer` 角色发送，方舟网关拒绝该角色。完整调用链：

**① `dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `resolveModelReasoning()`（lib/index.js 约 1047–1086 行）**

只要模型声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 且包含非 `off` 档位，就返回 `reasoning: true`：

```js
if (!declared.some(([level]) => level !== "off")) invalid(...);
// ...
return {
    reasoning: true,
    thinkingLevelMap: map
};
```

**② pi-ai → `convertMessages()`（`dist/api/openai-completions.js` 约 785–792 行）**

```js
if (context.systemPrompt) {
    const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;
    const role = useDeveloperRole ? "developer" : "system";
    params.push({ role: role, content: sanitizeSurrogates(context.systemPrompt) });
}
```

**③ pi-ai → `detectCompat()`（同文件约 1141–1148 行）——根因所在**

```js
const isNonStandard = isNvidia ||
    provider === "cerebras" || baseUrl.includes("cerebras.ai") ||
    provider === "xai" || baseUrl.includes("api.x.ai") ||
    isTogether || baseUrl.includes("chutes.ai") ||
    baseUrl.includes("deepseek.com") ||
    isZai || isMoonshot ||
    provider === "opencode" || baseUrl.includes("opencode.ai") ||
    isCloudflareWorkersAI || isCloudflareAiGateway ||
    isAntLing;
// ...
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter),
```

`isNonStandard` 名单覆盖了 nvidia/cerebras/xai/together/chutes.ai/deepseek.com/zai/moonshot/opencode.ai/cloudflare/ant-ling，但**没有覆盖 `volces.com`**，于是方舟被默认判定为「支持 developer 角色」。

**④ 配置层面无解**

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 配置项（lib/index.js 约 1375–1382 行）只开放了 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`：

```js
const compatProfile = z.object({
    thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
    supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean()
});
```

**没有 `supportsDeveloperRole` 开关**，自定义提供方用户无法通过 settings.yaml 关闭该行为。

② + ③ 两个条件同时成立 → 系统提示词以 `developer` 发出 → 方舟 400。默认的 `opencode-go`（`opencode.ai`）在 `isNonStandard` 名单中 → 使用 `system` → 正常，所以只有方舟端点失败。

## 修复方法（当前可用的本地补丁）

修改 pi-ai 的 `detectCompat()` 返回值，仅关闭方舟的 developer 角色（不动其它兼容位）：

```diff
-        supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter),
+        supportsDeveloperRole: (isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)) && !baseUrl.includes("volces.com"),
```

文件：`node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js`

## 修复结果（已实测验证）

通过 pi-ai 真实 `stream()` 路径（与 DSH 相同的代码路径）+ `onPayload` 抓取实际发出的 wire role，使用本机方舟密钥：

| 场景 | 发出的 role | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| ark-agent `plan/v3`（补丁后） | `system` | ✅ 请求成功，正常回复（含 thinking 块） |
| ark-code `coding/v3`（补丁后） | `system` | ✅ 请求成功，正常回复 |
| 强制 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`（模拟补丁前） | `developer` | ❌ 400，错误信息与最初报错完全一致 |

注意事项：

- 补丁只对新进程生效，运行中的 `dsh web` 需要重启；
- `npm` 重装 / 升级 dsh 后补丁丢失，需重新打；
- 备选思路：把 `volces.com` 加入 `isNonStandard` 也能修复，但会连带把 `supportsStore` 置 false（对方舟无实际影响，不过上文 diff 更保守）。

## 建议上游修复方向

1. pi-ai `detectCompat()` 识别 `volces.com`（或新增 ark 内置 provider），令 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`；
2. 在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 中开放 `supportsDeveloperRole` 布尔开关，允许自定义提供方按需关闭，无需改代码；
3. 先例：OpenClaw 项目遇到完全相同的故障（OpenAI 兼容后端拒绝 `developer` 角色），已通过强制非原生 OpenAI 端点 `supportsDeveloperRole=false` 修复：
   - issue: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27037
   - PR: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/29479

## 相关隐患（建议一并处理）

若改用 `openai-responses` 协议接方舟，同样的 developer 角色逻辑依然存在：

- `dist/api/openai-responses-shared.js` 约 92 行：`const role = model.reasoning && compat?.supportsDeveloperRole !== false ? "developer" : "system";`
- `dist/api/openai-responses.js` 约 52 行：`supportsDeveloperRole: model.compat?.supportsDeveloperRole ?? true`

当前 `openai-completions` 配置不受影响，但协议切换时同样会踩坑。

comments.body:
This report isolates an important compatibility boundary. I checked rc.7 (`99f6f02`) and the configuration surface confirms the operator-side gap:

- `reasoningEfforts` makes a hand-declared model reasoning-capable;
- pi-ai selects `developer` only when the model reasons and compatibility says that role is supported;
- the rc.7 Harness profile exposes `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`, but not `supportsDeveloperRole`.

Those three controls should stay separate. `thinkingFormat` changes the reasoning payload dialect. `supportsReasoningEffort` changes explicit effort support. Neither declares which system-message roles the gateway accepts.

For operators, the decisive evidence bundle is small: exact base URL and protocol, declared reasoning metadata, the outbound first message role, the complete 400 with request ID, and an A/B that changes only `developer` to `system`. Do not include the key or full prompt.

The safest immediate production response is a separately verified compatible route. A non-reasoning compatibility profile can be a bounded fallback if selectable reasoning is not required, but its actual wire role and model behavior must be captured. A direct dependency patch can prove the diagnosis in an isolated installation, but it is erased by reinstall or upgrade and requires a restart.

The durable fix is the one proposed here: expose `supportsDeveloperRole` as an explicit compatibility fact, or add a correct built-in detector, with independent tests for both completions and responses protocols.

I turned the decision path, recovery tradeoffs, and regression matrix into a visual runbook: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/openai-compatible-developer-role.html

Independent community handbook, not an official DeepSeek AI project.

records.title: [Bug Fix] Guard tool call name and id against null stream deltas in llm-deepseek
records.body:
### Problem
When connecting to OpenAI-compatible gateways and proxies (such as OpenCode, LiteLLM, OneAPI, etc.), tool call streaming deltas conform to the standard OpenAI SSE shape where the first chunk specifies `{ name: "tool_name", arguments: "" }`, and subsequent argument chunks send `{ name: null, arguments: "..." }`.

In `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`:
```typescript
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```
Because `null !== undefined` is `true` in JavaScript, the valid tool name captured from chunk 1 was being overwritten by `null` in chunk 2, causing the assembled tool call to have `name: ""` (empty string), leading to runtime `Error: unknown tool ""`.

---

### Solution & Commit
A patch with unit tests has been pushed to the fork:
👉 **Commit:** https://github.com/kolawong/deepseek-harness/commit/1aa1af2571
👉 **Branch:** https://github.com/kolawong/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/llm-deepseek-null-tool-delta

- Checked `typeof call.function?.name === 'string' && call.function.name.length > 0` before updating `block.name`.
- Checked `typeof call.id === 'string' && call.id.length > 0` before updating `block.callId`.
- Added unit test in `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts` covering SSE chunks with `{ name: null, id: null }` (31/31 Vitest tests passed).

Please consider cherry-picking this fix into master. Thank you!

records.title: llm-pi-ai 让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关可选思考强度（新增 supportsDeveloperRole 回退 system 角色；参考实现，AI 代写，仅供参考）
records.body:
## 正文 | Body

### 摘要 | Summary

**中文**：我是 DSH 使用者。用自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（如百炼 token plan 的 compatible-mode 端点）时，推理模型**选不了努力程度**：界面上没有档位可选，一旦发起带档位（推理）的请求还会 400。原因：pi-ai 对所有未收录的网关默认按"支持 `developer` 角色"探测，而不少网关只认 `system`。我加了一处小改动：给 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 透传 `supportsDeveloperRole` 兼容开关，让这类网关可以显式声明"不认 `developer`"，思考强度档位即可正常使用。改动由 AI agent 代写，**仅供参考**——我了解官方目前不接受外部 PR，请把它当作讨论素材，欢迎任何批评与建议。

**English**: I'm a DSH user. On custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (e.g. the Bailian token-plan `compatible-mode` endpoint), reasoning models **cannot select a reasoning effort**: no levels are offered, and an effort-carrying (reasoning) request fails with 400. The reason: pi-ai auto-detects every unrecognized gateway as supporting the `developer` role, but many gateways only accept `system`. This small change forwards a `supportsDeveloperRole` compat switch through `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, so such gateways can explicitly declare "no `developer` role" and effort selection works. It was drafted by an AI agent and is **for reference only** — I know external PRs aren't accepted at the moment, so treat it as discussion material. Any feedback is welcome.

### 现象 | Symptoms

**中文**：
- 配置：自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（openai-completions），如 `token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`，推理模型（qwen3.x、deepseek-v4-pro 等）；配置形式与官方指引一致。
- 问题：模型平时可用，但**无法选择思考强度**（effort 档位不出现在选择器里）；显式发起带档位的请求时报 400：`developer is not one of ['system','assistant','user','tool','function']`。

**English**:
- Setup: a custom OpenAI-compatible gateway (`api: openai-completions`), e.g. `token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`, with reasoning models (qwen3.x, deepseek-v4-pro, …), configured the official way.
- Problem: models work in general, but **reasoning effort cannot be selected** (no effort levels in the picker); an explicit effort-carrying request fails with 400: `developer is not one of ['system','assistant','user','tool','function']`.

### 根因（我的理解）| Root cause (as I understand it)

**中文**：
1. pi-ai 的 `detectCompat` 只把少数已知厂商列入"非标准"名单；**所有未收录的 baseURL 一律探测为 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`**（`openai-completions.js`：`isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)`）。
2. 模型一旦推理（reasoning），系统提示就按 `developer` 角色发送（`useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`）；只认 `system` 的网关（百炼风格）随即 400。
3. `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 只透传 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`，没有 `supportsDeveloperRole`，配置层无从覆盖探测结果；内置目录的标注又只按 route key 精确匹配，换一个 key 就继承不到。

**English**:
1. pi-ai's `detectCompat` lists only a few known vendors as "non-standard"; **every unrecognized baseURL is detected as `supportsDeveloperRole: true`** (`openai-completions.js`: `isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)`).
2. As soon as a model reasons, the system prompt goes out in the `developer` role (`useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`); `system`-only gateways (Bailian-style) answer 400.
3. `dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `PiAiCompatProfile` forwards only `thinkingFormat` + `supportsReasoningEffort` — no `supportsDeveloperRole`, so a profile cannot override the detection; and the built-in catalog's flag only applies to its exact route key.

### 参考实现 | Reference implementation

**中文**：
- `PiAiCompatProfile` 新增 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`，按 模型 → 路由 → 已装 catalog 条目 → pi-ai URL 探测 的顺序解析；schema 接受该布尔开关。
- 配置 `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` 后：思考强度档位出现在选择器里，请求以 `system` 角色发送，不再 400。
- 测试与文档（中英）一并更新。分支：`fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness` → `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role`（提交 `78a4dfd4a7`）。
- 验证：vitest 59/59、typecheck 与 lint 全绿；实测百炼推理模型档位可选、请求 200（`developer` → 400 对照）。

**English**:
- Adds `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean` to `PiAiCompatProfile`, resolved model → route → installed catalog entry → pi-ai's URL guess; schema accepts it.
- With `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }`: effort levels appear in the picker and requests go out with the `system` role — no more 400.
- Tests + docs (en/zh) updated. Branch: `fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness` → `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role` (commit `78a4dfd4a7`).
- Verified: vitest 59/59, typecheck + lint green; live check — Bailian reasoning models offer effort levels and answer 200 (with `developer` → 400 as the control).

### 直接试用 | Try it directly

**中文**：
如果你想直接跑一下这份改动，我维护的 fork 里就是当前状态：
- 分支：`feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role`（提交 `78a4dfd4a7`）
- 仓库：https://github.com/fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness
- 用法：在 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` 的目标网关下加 `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` 即可。

**English**:
If you'd like to try the change directly, my fork has it live:
- Branch: `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role` (commit `78a4dfd4a7`)
- Repo: https://github.com/fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness
- Usage: add `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` under the target gateway in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`.

### 局限 | Caveats

**中文**：
- 改动由 AI agent 生成，未经维护者评审；命名与暴露面未必符合项目方向。
- 仅针对百炼 compatible-mode 实测过；只认 `system` 的其它自定义网关行为类似但未逐一验证。
- 如果团队有更合适的方案（例如在模型发现阶段探测角色/档位支持），我随时愿意补充用例、调整设计或放弃此方案。

**English**:
- Generated by an AI agent; not reviewed by maintainers — naming and surface may not fit the project's direction.
- Tested only against Bailian's compatible mode; other `system`-only custom gateways should behave the same but aren't individually verified.
- Happy to provide more test cases, adjust the design, or drop it if the team prefers another approach (e.g. probing role/effort support at discovery time).

### 致谢 | Thanks

**中文**：感谢阅读。如有用得上我的地方（补测试、改设计、写文档），随时说一声。

**English**: Thanks for reading. Happy to help with more tests, design changes, or docs if useful.

_最后更新 / Last updated: 2026-08-19_

records.title: pi-ai adapter: third-party "server_error"/overload responses are not classified as SERVER and never retried
records.body:
Environment / 环境
DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.5 (commit 47f943859b, 2026-08-13)
Surface: Web GUI (dsh web), agent run / model request
Provider path: third-party OpenAI-compatible API via pi-ai adapter (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai)
Retry plugin: llm-retry present in base bundle (packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml)

Describe the bug / 问题描述
第三方 provider 过载时返回标准错误体：
Error Code server_error: Our servers are currently overloaded. Please try again later.
DSH 直接显示“本轮运行失败”，一次重试都不发生；默认重试策略本应覆盖这类瞬时故障（SERVER/RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT），每次重试都立刻再次失败。

Steps to reproduce / 复现步骤
配置一个会返回 server_error/overload 文案（文本中无 5xx 数字）的第三方 OpenAI 兼容 provider
发送消息触发上游过载错误
观察：本轮立即失败，会话日志无 llm/retry 事件——完全没有退避重试

Expected / Actual
期望：归类为可重试 SERVER，按默认退避重试 2 次（500ms→10s，10% 抖动）后才失败
实际：首次请求即失败，直接把上游原文展示给用户

Root cause / 根因分析
pi-ai 将捕获异常扁平化为 error.message，丢失原始 Error/cause（stream.ts 已有注释），只能文本分类
classifyPiAiError 只把含 5xx 数字的文案（如 HTTP 500）归为 SERVER；server_error: ... 无数字 → 落入兜底 PI_AI_ERROR
PI_AI_ERROR 不在默认重试码白名单（packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts）→ llm-retry 直接放行 → 本轮以错误终结

Relevant code / 相关位置
packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts（修复点）· packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts · packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts · packages/llm/llm-retry/src/index.ts · packages/extensions/ui-cordis/src/client/locales.ts

comments.body:
Thanks @YangZiCong2503416920 for the report and the original diagnosis.

I reproduced this on master at [`141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534). The reported provider text reaches pi-ai as a flattened `errorMessage`, but `classifyPiAiError()` recognizes numeric 5xx status text and not the explicit `server_error` marker. It therefore falls through to `PI_AI_ERROR`; the normal provider retry policy includes `SERVER` but deliberately excludes that catch-all.

I prepared a narrow patch that:

- maps a case-insensitive, word-bounded `server_error` marker to the existing `SERVER` code;
- preserves the higher-priority authentication, quota, rate-limit, and request-size classifications;
- keeps generic `server` prose and `client_error` in `PI_AI_ERROR`;
- adds the reported wording plus negative lookalikes to the adapter regression suite; and
- documents the classifier and retry-policy boundary in the package README and an Agent Note.

Fork commit: [`736420c68e99ad690f1ccec4a81f00391f3d2825`](https://github.com/GCSimba/deepseek-harness/commit/736420c68e99ad690f1ccec4a81f00391f3d2825)

Branch: [`codex/fix-pi-ai-server-error-classification`](https://github.com/GCSimba/deepseek-harness/tree/codex/fix-pi-ai-server-error-classification)

Validation:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts --coverage --coverage.include='packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts'` — 73/73 tests passed; `stream.ts` reached 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines.
- `pnpm run build` — passed.
- `pnpm run lint` — passed.
- `pnpm run doc-sync` — 27 of 28 checks passed; only the symlink verifier was blocked on this Windows checkout by `EPERM` while inspecting existing repository symlinks.
- Repository commit and pre-push hooks completed successfully.

The patch does not add `PI_AI_ERROR` to the retryable set, change error text or schemas, alter retry limits, or make direct `ctx.llm.stream()` calls multi-attempt. I left it as a fork commit because the project's [contribution guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) currently does not accept external pull requests.

AI-assisted repository audit and implementation; I reviewed the source, reproduced the failure, and ran every validation listed above. The commit records `Codex <noreply@openai.com>` as a co-author.

I consolidated this into a source-backed operator runbook: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pi-ai-server-error-retry.html

One version-sensitive correction is useful for operators: at rc.8 (`141eb6f`), omitted provider policy resolves to **five retries after the initial request**, not two. The default eligible codes are `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TIMEOUT`, and `TRANSPORT`, with 500ms–10s bounded exponential backoff and 10% jitter. A textual `server_error` still falls through to `PI_AI_ERROR`, so those defaults never execute.

The guide separates four proofs: upstream transient evidence, ordered adapter classification, the selected route policy, and the durable executor. For one turn/step, `llm/retry` proves scheduling was appended before the wait, while the paired `llm/retry-started` proves another request actually began. A scheduled-only event can mean cancellation or disposal; no events can mean classification, policy, exhaustion, an excessive provider delay, or a direct `ctx.llm.stream()` call.

It also explains why adding the catch-all `PI_AI_ERROR` to `retryableCodes` is unsafe, and pins the narrow word-bounded source fix plus positive, negative, and precedence-collision tests.

Canonical guide: https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/pi-ai-server-error-not-retried.md

records.title: dsh --profile headless 可以支持 reasoningEfforts 项吗？
records.body: 请问官方有没计划做这个功能，类似 oh-my-pi (omp)  的 --thinking max这样。

comments.body: I checked the rc.8 headless parser. Today there is no per-invocation --thinking max flag: the shipped headless app accepts the task positional and --help. The fresh Agent instead reads the shared agent-default-model selection. Two existing controls are easy to confuse: - reasoningEfforts on a model declares which levels that exact model offers and how they map to wire values. - reasoning on an llm-pi-ai provider profile selects the deployment default, for example reasoning: max. If Web and headless use the same DSH_HOME, a successful Web model-picker selection (including effort) is stored in settings.yaml; the next fresh headless Agent reads that shared default. For isolated automation, an explicit --patch overlay before the task can target the adapter profile without mutating a shared human default. The official DeepSeek adapter uses different field names (thinking plus reasoningEffort in the upstream example), so fields should not be copied between adapter families. The effective value should be verified from the durable request header and sanitized wire request, not only from visible thinking text. I documented the current paths, precedence questions a future CLI flag must answer, examples, and acceptance gates here: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/headless-reasoning-effort.html

records.title: Configuring Bailian Token Plan via custom provider silently breaks: schema rejection, missing `developer` compat, and unintuitive `models` replacement semantics
records.body:
## Environment

- DSH Desktop: 2.0.1
- Harness: 0.1.0-rc.7
- pi-ai: bundled with desktop
- Provider endpoint: `https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` (Bailian Token Plan CN)
- OS: Windows

## Summary

When a user manually configures the Bailian Token Plan endpoint as a custom provider (instead of using the built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route), they encounter three cascading failures that are extremely difficult to diagnose:

1. **Reasoning effort selector does not appear** for any model
2. **`developer` role 400 error** from the Bailian API
3. **"API key is invalid"** after attempting to fix #2 by adding `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` at the route level

All three stem from configuration-layer UX issues in `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, not from the Bailian API itself. The built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route handles all of these correctly, but there is no GUI guidance to use it.

## Detailed Reproduction

### Step 1: User adds Bailian as a custom provider

This is the natural first approach — the GUI offers "Add Custom Provider" but does not surface the built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    aibaba:
      displayName: Bailian
      apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
      models:
        - id: qwen3.7-max
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
        # ... more models
```

**Result**: No reasoning effort selector appears for any model. The models work for basic chat, but reasoning capability is invisible.

**Root cause**: Hand-declared models have no reasoning metadata. The settings-models UI deliberately does not expose `reasoningEfforts` editing (source comment: *"There is deliberately no reasoning-effort control, here or on the editor"*). Without `reasoningEfforts`, `resolveModelReasoning` returns `{reasoning: false}` → `reasoningInfo()` returns `{}` → UI hides the selector.

### Step 2: User encounters `developer` role 400 error

After extended multi-turn usage, requests fail with:

```
400 {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']"}}
```

**Root cause**: `detectCompat()` in `openai-completions.js` defaults `supportsDeveloperRole: true` for the Bailian URL (it's not in the `isNonStandard` list). The built-in catalog explicitly sets `supportsDeveloperRole: false` for every Bailian model, but hand-declared routes lose this metadata. When `model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole` evaluates to true, DSH sends `role: "developer"` which Bailian rejects.

### Step 3: User tries to fix it and makes things worse

Attempting to add `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` at the route level:

```yaml
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  displayName: Bailian
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
  compat:
    supportsDeveloperRole: false   # ← NOT in compatProfile schema
  models:
    - id: wan2.7-image
    # ...
```

**Result**: The entire `llm-pi-ai` provider section fails schema validation silently. The route is never registered. Subsequent requests fail with "API key is invalid" or "no adapter registered for provider qwen-token-plan-cn" — neither of which points to the actual cause (schema rejection).

**Root cause**: `compatProfile` only accepts `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`. Writing any other field causes `assertServiceable` → `resolveProfiles` to throw. The `onChange` handler catches this and logs *"keeping the previously registered routes after a refused update"*, but the user sees only the downstream symptom ("API key is invalid"), not the validation failure.

## What Works (But Is Undiscoverable)

The built-in `qwen-token-plan-cn` catalog route handles everything correctly with just:

```yaml
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  displayName: Bailian
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
```

No `api`, `baseURL`, `models`, or `compat` needed. All ~15 text models inherit correct reasoning metadata, `supportsDeveloperRole: false`, and DeepSeek's `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true`.

**But there is no way for a user to discover this** without reading source code.

## Structural Limitation: `models` Replacement Semantics

Writing a `models` list on a catalog route **completely replaces** the built-in catalog (line 1139 of `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js`):

```js
const entries = configured.length > 0 ? configured : [...defaults.values()].map(...)
```

This means users cannot supplement the built-in catalog with additional models (e.g., image/audio models not in the catalog). They must choose between:

- Full built-in catalog (correct compat, but no custom models)
- Custom model list (loses all built-in metadata including critical compat flags)

There is no merge mode.

## Suggested Improvements

### 1. Surface built-in catalog providers in the GUI

Add a "Use Built-in Provider" option in the Models settings page that lists available catalog routes (`qwen-token-plan-cn`, `deepseek`, etc.) alongside the manual "Add Custom Provider" flow. This would prevent users from ever needing to hand-configure endpoints that already have full catalog support.

### 2. Provide explicit errors on schema validation failure

When `assertServiceable` / `resolveProfiles` throws during `onChange`, the error should be surfaced to the user (toast notification, settings page banner, or at minimum a prominent log entry) rather than silently falling back to previous routes. The current behavior — logging *"keeping the previously registered routes after a refused update"* to the error log while the user sees an unrelated "API key is invalid" — makes diagnosis nearly impossible.

Specifically, when `compatProfile` rejects an unknown field like `supportsDeveloperRole`, the error message should name the invalid field and suggest valid alternatives.

### 3. Consider a `models` merge mode for catalog routes

Allow catalog routes to declare additional models without replacing the entire catalog. For example:

```yaml
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
  extraModels:           # merge instead of replace
    - id: wan2.7-image
    - id: qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus
```

Or alternatively, allow per-model compat overrides on catalog routes so users can fix individual fields without losing the rest of the catalog metadata.

### 4. Document the `compatProfile` schema boundary

The fact that only `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort` are user-configurable compat fields is not documented anywhere visible to users. The other dozen+ compat fields (`supportsDeveloperRole`, `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages`, `supportsStore`, etc.) are internal-only but look like reasonable configuration options. A docs page or inline schema description listing allowed fields would prevent silent misconfiguration.

## Impact

These issues affect any user who configures a provider endpoint that happens to have built-in catalog support but doesn't know to use the catalog route name. The Bailian Token Plan case is particularly painful because:

- The endpoint is widely used in China
- The `developer` role error only manifests after multi-turn usage (not on first request)
- The attempted fix (adding `supportsDeveloperRole`) triggers a completely different failure mode
- The error messages at each stage point in wrong directions

I've written a detailed troubleshooting guide based on my debugging experience that I'd be happy to contribute as documentation if helpful.

comments.body:
I checked this across the tagged rc.7 and rc.8 sources. There is an important release boundary that changes the safest answer.

For rc.7, `compatProfile` exposes only `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`; `supportsDeveloperRole` is not a valid user-configurable key. The least fragile recovery is therefore the minimal installed catalog route:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    qwen-token-plan-cn:
      displayName: Bailian Token Plan CN
      apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
```

Omitting `api`, `baseURL`, and `models` preserves the installed endpoint, model metadata, reasoning levels, and vendor compatibility. A 400 that explicitly rejects `developer` also proves the request reached and authenticated with the provider; it should not be diagnosed first as an invalid key.

rc.8 expands the configurable compat schema and does include `supportsDeveloperRole`, so a genuinely custom `openai-completions` route can set it to `false`. rc.8 also documents `modelOverrides`: it can adjust one installed catalog model while retaining the rest. It does not add an unknown model, cannot coexist with a replacing `models` list, and `models` remains full replacement rather than append.

I published a version-aware runbook with the exact failure classification, minimal route, replacement/override rules, custom-model workflow, rollback, and acceptance gates:
https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/bailian-token-plan.html

That distinction should keep rc.7 users from applying an rc.8-compatible field and then chasing the downstream registration/auth symptom.

comments.body:
There is a second boundary worth preserving here: a successful Go model listing does not make every returned model callable through one DSH custom route.

The current official OpenCode Go table mixes three endpoints and protocols under the same `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1` prefix:

- DeepSeek V4 models: `/chat/completions` → `openai-completions`
- GPT 5.6 Luna: `/responses` → `openai-responses`
- Qwen and MiniMax entries: `/messages` → `anthropic-messages`

In DSH rc.8, **Fetch available models** reads ids, optional names, and optional capacity fields from `GET /models`. It does not import a per-model protocol. A custom provider route has one route-level `api`, while its `models` entries cannot each name a different protocol. Adopting the full mixed listing into one route can therefore make only one protocol family work and leave the others looking like credential failures.

A safer setup is three protocol-homogeneous DSH provider routes sharing the same credential reference and Go base prefix. The Messages route must be entered manually because rc.8 intentionally limits network discovery to OpenAI Completions and Responses listings.

The reported account option for models deployed in China is a separate entitlement and data-residency decision. It can change model availability, but it should not be treated as a universal fix for a wrong request path.

Full rc.8 routing examples and evidence matrix: [canonical guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/opencode-go-model-routing.md) · [visual map](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/opencode-go-model-routing.html).

Disclosure: I maintain the independent SandBase DeepSeek Harness Handbook.

records.body: 用qwen，7.7tok/s 切回ds，81tok/s 又遇到相似问题的吗？

comments.body:
﻿想帮你定位，但还缺几个关键信息：
1. 这个 qwen 是**本地部署**（ollama/vllm 等）还是**云端 API**（阿里云百炼等）？
2. 模型具体是哪个（如 qwen2.5:7b / qwen-max）？如果是本地，用的什么量化、什么显卡/显存？
3. 对比的 81 tok/s 是 DeepSeek 官方 API 吗？

如果 qwen 是本地跑的，7.7 tok/s 在 CPU 推理或小显存下是正常水平；如果是 API 却这么慢，则要看网络和并发配置。贴一下部署方式和 `dsh model` 的输出，我可以帮你进一步排查。

1、qwen3.8-max 云端API（百炼）
2、deepseek官方API
3、我是用harness做了gateway，在本地项目使用其编排功能。用的python sdk

﻿qwen3.8-max 是百炼的 max 档，本来就是"慢但聪明"那类，跟 v4 flash 这种快速档比 tok/s 没啥意义，两个不是一个速度等级。7.7 对 max 档来说算正常水平

想确认是不是 harness 转发拖慢的，最省事的办法是绕开它直连百炼测一次：

```python
import time
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="<key>", base_url="https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1")
t0 = time.time()
text = ""
for chunk in client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen3-8-max",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "写300字短文"}],
    stream=True,
):
    if chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
        text += chunk.choices[0].delta.content
print(len(text) / (time.time() - t0), "字/s")
```

直连也这速度就是模型/百炼的锅；直连快很多再回来查 harness。

还有qwen3 系列默认可能带思考模式，思考不算 tok 但特别费时间，看看有没有传 `enable_thinking: false`。

records.title: Support OAuth-protected MCP servers in @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
records.body:
# Support OAuth-protected MCP servers in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`

## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` can only authenticate to MCP servers via a static
`headers` map. Servers that use OAuth (the auth mechanism specified for remote
MCP servers, and increasingly common for hosted/internal ones) cannot be used at
all.

The underlying `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` — already a direct dependency of this
package — ships a complete OAuth client implementation, and the transports this
plugin constructs already accept an `authProvider` option that wires it up. The
gap is that DSH never passes one.

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh` | `0.1.0-rc.7` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | `0.1.0-rc.7` |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` | `1.30.0` (declared `^1.12.0`) |
| Node | `v22.23.1` |
| Platform | macOS |

## Reproduction

Register any OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP MCP server, e.g. in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: mcp-example
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: example
    transport: streamable-http
    url: https://example.internal/mcp
```

The server responds to `initialize` with:

```
HTTP/2 401
www-authenticate: Bearer error="unauthorized",
  error_description="Authorization needed",
  resource_metadata="https://example.internal/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"
```

and that `.well-known` document advertises standard protected-resource metadata:

```json
{
  "resource": "https://example.internal",
  "authorization_servers": ["https://example.internal"],
  "scopes_supported": ["openid", "email"],
  "bearer_methods_supported": ["header"]
}
```

Result: discovery fails. With `failOnStartupError: false` (the default) the
plugin activates with **no tools** and the server is silently unusable; with
`true` it rejects activation. There is no configuration that succeeds, because
the only auth surface is a static header and the token these flows issue is
short-lived (the case that prompted this: ~1 hour, requiring refresh).

Other MCP clients (e.g. Claude Code) connect to the same server with nothing
more than `{"type": "http", "url": "…"}` — they run the OAuth flow themselves
and persist the resulting tokens.

## Why this is a small change

Everything needed is already vendored in the SDK this package depends on.

**1. The transports already accept an auth provider.**
`StreamableHTTPClientTransportOptions.authProvider?: OAuthClientProvider`, with
documented behaviour (`dist/esm/client/streamableHttp.d.ts`):

> When an `authProvider` is specified and the connection is started:
> 1. The connection is attempted with any existing access token from the `authProvider`.
> 2. If the access token has expired, the `authProvider` is used to refresh the token.
> …
> If an `authProvider` is not provided, and auth is required, an `UnauthorizedError` will be thrown.

The 401-retry, refresh, and re-auth logic is implemented in the transport
(including a circuit breaker against auth-success-then-401 recursion). `sse.js`
has the same option.

**2. The OAuth protocol work is implemented.**
`dist/esm/client/auth.js` exports, among others:

- `auth()` — the full orchestration entry point
- `discoverOAuthProtectedResourceMetadata()` — consumes exactly the
  `resource_metadata` pointer above
- `discoverAuthorizationServerMetadata()` / `discoverOAuthServerInfo()`
- `registerClient()` — dynamic client registration
- `startAuthorization()` / `exchangeAuthorization()` — PKCE authorization code
- `refreshAuthorization()` — token refresh

**3. DSH currently opts out.** The transport is constructed as:

```js
new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(new URL(config.url) /*, no authProvider */)
```

## Proposed change

Implement an `OAuthClientProvider` and pass it to the transport when a server is
configured for OAuth. The interface is a set of small persistence accessors:

| Member | Role |
|---|---|
| `clientMetadata` / `clientInformation()` / `saveClientInformation()` | client identity, incl. dynamic registration |
| `tokens()` / `saveTokens()` | access + refresh token persistence |
| `redirectToAuthorization()` | begin the interactive leg |
| `saveCodeVerifier()` / `codeVerifier()` | PKCE |
| `state?()` | CSRF state |

Suggested config surface (additive, backwards compatible — `headers` keeps
working unchanged):

```yaml
- id: mcp-example
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: example
    transport: streamable-http
    url: https://example.internal/mcp
    auth:
      mode: oauth            # or: none (default) | client-credentials
      scopes: [openid, email]   # optional; else from resource metadata
```

### Design questions worth settling in review

- **Token storage.** Tokens and refresh tokens are secrets and must not land in
  `cordis.patch.yml` or logs. DSH already has `~/.dsh/storages/` and
  `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`; an OS-keychain-backed store is the stronger
  option on macOS. Storage should be keyed per `(serverName, resource)` so two
  servers on one host don't collide.
- **The interactive leg.** `redirectToAuthorization()` needs a browser plus a
  loopback redirect listener. DSH has an advantage here: the Web GUI is already
  a local server (`127.0.0.1:3080`), so the callback route and an
  "authorize this MCP server" affordance have a natural home, rather than
  needing a throwaway HTTP listener.
- **Headless / remote sessions.** Where no browser is available, support a
  non-interactive path. The SDK explicitly allows `redirectUrl: undefined` for
  `client_credentials` and `jwt-bearer`, which covers service accounts — this
  is likely the right default for CI and server deployments.
- **Refresh vs. reconnect budget.** Token refresh should not be conflated with
  the existing `reconnect.maxAttempts` outage budget; an expiring token is a
  routine, expected event, not an outage.
- **Failure surfacing.** A server needing authorization should say so clearly
  (matching the existing user-visible reconnect logging) rather than presenting
  as "activated with zero tools", which is what happens today.

## Impact

Without this, DSH cannot use any OAuth-protected MCP server. That currently
includes hosted/managed MCP offerings and internal corporate servers behind
SSO — a growing share of non-local servers, and the ones where the stdio
"just spawn it locally" escape hatch does not apply. The workaround, pasting a
short-lived bearer token into a config file, means writing a live credential to
disk and re-pasting it on every expiry.

comments.body:
There is now an installable ecosystem path for this without maintaining a
local OAuth forwarding bridge. `pi2dsh` runs the unmodified
`pi-mcp-adapter` package as a DSH plugin: the package continues to own MCP
transport, OAuth, cache, and refresh behavior, while pi2dsh maps its public
Host ABI onto DSH commands, user questions, tools, and the native model loop.

Installation still uses only the official DSH plugin workflow:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-mcp-adapter
```

After declaring the remote server in the standard `.mcp.json` format (for
Atlassian, `https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2` with `auth: "oauth"`),
restart the profile and run this in either dsh-TUI or Web:

```text
/mcp-auth atlassian
```

The acceptance run used the real Atlassian service, not a mock: authorization
server discovery, Dynamic Client Registration, PKCE, the browser localhost
callback, secure credential persistence, MCP reconnect, and discovery of 26
tools all completed. DeepSeek then called the read-only
`atlassian_atlassianUserInfo` tool from both DSH Web and dsh-TUI; the durable
DSH session log contains a non-error `tool/result`. On a local machine the
callback completes automatically and withdraws the fallback paste prompt;
manual URL paste is only needed for SSH/cross-machine browsers that cannot
reach the callback listener. `/pi-mcp logout atlassian` removes the stored
credential.

This is an immediately usable ecosystem compatibility route; it does not claim
that the official `dsh-mcp-client` implementation has been changed. A future
first-party OAuth path can replace it cleanly.

- https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh
- https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/tui-mcp

records.title: dsh 不从网关实时拉取模型列表，只用 pi-ai catalog 快照：opencode-go 新模型显示不出来；临时方案（手动声明 openai-completions 路由）又因协议不同，同一提供商的模型被拆成两个 provider
records.body:
背景 / 痛点
Web 设置 → 模型页的「拉取可用模型（Fetch available models）」本意是自动获取某提供商在线在售的模型清单。但实测发现：

对 pi-ai catalog 路由（如 opencode-go），它不会发任何网络请求，直接返回已安装 @earendil-works/pi-ai 包内写死的 catalog 快照；
结果就是 opencode-go 网关新上线的模型永远不显示，只能手动逐条填写；
想绕开 catalog 走实时拉取，必须手动声明一个 openai-completions 协议的路由（如 opencode-go-live）。但 opencode-go 这个 gateway 在 catalog 里默认用的是非 openai 协议，于是同一个提供商的一批模型被迫拆到两个 provider 下配置，无法合并成一个提供商，管理和切换都很别扭。
复现
dsh 0.1.0-rc.8，安装 pi-ai 适配器；在 $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml 加目录路由 opencode-go（仅 apiKeyEnv）；
Web → 设置 → 模型 → opencode-go → 「拉取可用模型」；
结果：只返回已安装 pi-ai@0.82.1 快照里的 16 个模型，零网络请求；
而 opencode-go 线上端点（
https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models
）实际在售 28 个模型。
根因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js 的 discoverModels() 对 catalog 内已存在的提供商直接短路：

js
复制
if (request.provider !== void 0) {
    const installed = catalogModels(request.provider);
    if (installed.size > 0) return [...installed.values()].map(...) // 直接返回快照，不 fetch
}
只有 pi-ai 不认识（未内置）的提供商才会走到 GET {baseURL}/models 实时探测，且此时协议必须是 LISTABLE_PROTOCOLS（如 openai-completions）里可读取列表的那几类。

证据
pi-ai 0.82.1（已安装）：opencode-go catalog = 16 个模型；
线上端点：28 个，其中 12 个不在快照里（如 glm-5.3、qwen3.8-max、gpt-5.6-luna、qwen3.5-plus、mimo-v2-omni、kimi-k2.5、hy3-preview、ox-alpha-free、muse-spark-1.2-contributor 等）；
下载 0.84.2 tarball 核对：opencode-go 仍只有 19 个——只新增 glm-5.3、qwen3.8-max、gpt-5.6-luna，12 个里仍有 9 个缺失（快照永远追不上线上）；
dsh-llm-pi-ai 最新版（0.1.1-rc.1）仍钉死 @earendil-works/pi-ai: ^0.82.1（0.x 的 caret 语义 = <0.83.0），所以官方 npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest 也升不到 0.83/0.84。
为什么「手动配置」也救不了这个使用体验
为了拿全量，我用手声明路由 opencode-go-live（api: openai-completions + baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1）实时拉到了 28 个模型。但问题在于：

协议被迫分家：同一个网关，catalog 里的 opencode-go 用其原生协议；手动声明又只能用 openai-completions。于是同一个提供商的 28 个模型分裂在两处，用户得在 UI/配置里维护两份 provider，无法用一个 opencode-go 统一包含 catalog 全部 + 新模型；
丢失元数据：实时拉取拿不到 catalog 提供的 contextWindow、maxTokens、reasoningEfforts、compat、input 多模态等字段，多模态识图能力（input: [text, image]）还得靠用户逐个去查证后手填（我为此查了 pi-ai catalog 与多篇厂商资料才补全 13 个可识图模型）；
每新增一个模型都要手动处理。
建议（满足任意一条即可明显改善）
catalog 路由也支持实时探测：点「拉取可用模型」时，对已内置 catalog 的 provider 同时请求其端点 GET /models，把线上结果放进选择器供用户勾选采纳，而不是只回快照；
同一 provider 可多协议并存 / 能合并实时结果进 catalog 路由的 models：让用户能把「opencode-go 原生协议 catalog」和「openai-completions 实时拉取」合并在一个 provider 里，避免同一提供商模型被拆成两个 provider；
显示快照版本：标出每条路由当前用的是哪个 pi-ai catalog 快照，让滞后可见、也知道该等哪次升级；
放宽依赖范围（^0.82.1 → 可更新），让 catalog 更新能随正常的全局升级落地；
（可选） 提供「把 catalog / 实时拉取结果同步写进路由 models」的动作，自动带上 contextWindow/maxTokens/input 等元数据，控制权仍归用户。
连带发现
内置 DeepSeek 官方适配器（@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek）根本没有注册模型发现能力（没有 registerModelDiscovery），即使 DeepSeek 官方有 OpenAI 兼容的 GET /models，内置的 deepseek-official 提供商也同样无法自动获取模型——同类问题。

环境
dsh 0.1.0-rc.8（全局 npm），macOS
@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.82.1
Web 模型设置页（dsh-client-ui-settings-models）

records.title: llm-pi-ai drops the reasoning-token breakdown pi-ai already reports
records.body:
`mapUsage` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` does not map pi-ai's `Usage.reasoning`, so `TokenUsage.reasoningTokens` is always absent on a pi-ai route even when the provider reports a breakdown.

The README explains the omission as an absence upstream:

> pi-ai folds reasoning tokens into output usage; there is no separate reasoning count to map.

The first half is accurate — `output` already includes those tokens — but pi-ai does expose the breakdown separately:

```ts
// @earendil-works/pi-ai dist/types.d.ts:263
/**
 * Reasoning/thinking tokens, when the provider reports them. This is a subset of
 * `output`: `output` already includes these tokens.
 */
reasoning?: number;
```

It is populated for `openai-completions` (`dist/api/openai-completions.js:1077`):

```js
reasoning: rawUsage.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens || 0,
```

but `lib/index.js:418` maps only four fields:

```js
function mapUsage(usage) {
	return {
		inputTokens: usage.input,
		outputTokens: usage.output,
		...usage.cacheRead > 0 ? { cacheReadTokens: usage.cacheRead } : {},
		...usage.cacheWrite > 0 ? { cacheWriteTokens: usage.cacheWrite } : {}
	};
}
```

`TokenUsage.reasoningTokens` exists (`dsh-llm/lib/types/types.d.ts:128`) and `dsh-llm-deepseek` maps it (`lib/index.js:326-331`), so the two adapters disagree about the same endpoint shape.

## Reproduction

A local OpenAI-compatible server returning `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`, driven through `ctx.llm.stream()` with the same prompt on each adapter:

```
llm-pi-ai      (api: openai-completions)  usage = {"inputTokens":26,"outputTokens":63}
llm-deepseek   (same endpoint)            usage = {"inputTokens":56,"outputTokens":62,"reasoningTokens":55}
```

The endpoint's own response carries the breakdown in both cases:

```json
"completion_tokens_details": {"reasoning_tokens": 42}
```

## Suggested fix

Reasoning is a subset of output, so it rides alongside the output count rather than adding to it:

```js
...usage.reasoning === void 0 ? {} : { reasoningTokens: usage.reasoning }
```

Tested against `0.1.1-rc.1`: `reasoningTokens` then arrives and stays `<= outputTokens`.

Filed here rather than as an issue because this repository has Issues disabled.

records.title: Feature request: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Antigravity accounts
records.body:
It would be useful if DeepSeek Harness could offer an optional “Connect account” flow for supported AI providers such as ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, and Antigravity.

The goal would be to let users sign in with a provider account and use any plan entitlements or supported capabilities available through that provider, without manually configuring API keys where an official integration is available.

Suggested requirements:
- Use official OAuth or other provider-approved authentication flows only.
- Clearly show which provider, account, plan, and capabilities are connected.
- Never store user passwords; store only the minimum secure tokens required.
- Support disconnecting an account and revoking access at any time.
- Gracefully fall back to API-key or gateway configuration when account-plan access is not supported by the provider.

This could make setup easier for people who already subscribe to these services. Is this technically and policy-wise feasible for the supported providers?

records.title: 网关 finish_reason: network_error 未被重试（根因 + 已测试修复 + 过渡插件）
records.body:
## 问题现象

在 OpenAI 兼容网关（如 OpenCode Zen）后面，turn 会直接硬失败，错误串恒定：

```
Provider finish_reason: network_error
```

网关把自身上游连接的瞬时失败作为流的 `finish_reason` 上报；立即重试几乎总能成功（同类报告见 anomalyco/opencode#41236）。dsh 把该失败归类为不可重试，于是整个 turn 硬失败而不是重试——一次真实会话中，subagent 通道连续 8 次都挂在这个串上。

## 根因

两个 adapter 把线上 `finish_reason` 翻译成错误码，都漏掉了 network 变体：

1. **llm-pi-ai** — pi-ai 0.82 把未知 `finish_reason` 映射为 `stopReason: 'error'`，errorMessage 为 `Provider finish_reason: network_error`（`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `api/openai-completions.js` 的 `mapStopReason`）。随后 `classifyPiAiError`（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`）用 `/\b(?:network|connection|socket|fetch)\b/` 匹配——但 `\b` 在 `k` 与 `_` 之间不成立（下划线是 word 字符），`network_error` 落到 `PI_AI_ERROR`，而它不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 里。`llm-retry` 放行，turn 失败。
2. **llm-deepseek** — `mapFinishReason`（`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`）把未知 reason 大写化为失败码：`network_error` → `NETWORK_ERROR`，同样不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`。

## 参照

opencode 在 2026-08-21 修复了同样的网关行为：

- anomalyco/opencode@40282c1 — 可重试正则从 `network error` 扩为 `network[-_\s]error`，覆盖连字符/下划线变体。
- anomalyco/opencode@e0b9e68 — finish-step 事件 `rawFinishReason === "network_error"` 时按失败处理，进入既有重试管线（测试断言第 2 次尝试成功）。

## 修复（已备好，已测试）

由于仓库当前不接受外部 PR，修复已在 fork 分支上完成并充分测试：

https://github.com/fan56/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/network-error-retryable

- `llm-pi-ai`：`classifyPiAiError` 在既有 alternation 之前增加显式的 `/network[-_ ]error/i` 分支，三种拼写都归 `TRANSPORT`。既有匹配（AUTH/quota/429/4xx/5xx/timeout/流截断/ECONN*/terminated/premature close）全部不动。
- `llm-deepseek`：`mapFinishReason` 把 `network_error` / `network-error` 映射为 `{kind:'error', failure:{message:'model stopped: <reason>', code:'TRANSPORT'}}`。

`TRANSPORT` 已在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 中，无需改动 retry policy。

测试：`llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts` 扩展了 transport wording 表；`llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts` 增加 `mapFinishReason` 用例。`vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai packages/llm/llm-deepseek` → 608 全过；`pnpm run typecheck` → 干净。如果团队愿意合入，我可以随时 rebase/调整。

## 已发布版本的过渡插件

给已发布版本用户的插件（在 `agent/request-error` waterfall 末端重试这类失败，仅当所有下游 listener 都弃权时才行动）：

- 仓库：https://github.com/fan56/dsh-llm-net-retry
- npm：`@aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry@0.1.0`（`dsh plugin --profile tui add @aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry`）

它的 e2e 用真实 agent loop + `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter 打一个脚本化网关（前两次请求回 `finish_reason: network_error`），断言第三次完成 turn。基础修复合入后该插件自然无害：它只在整个 waterfall 弃权时行动，且绝不触碰 llm-retry 自身的计数。已在真实 dsh 0.1.0-rc.8 TUI 宿主上验证——见下方更新评论。

## 效果

修复后，网关 `network_error` 在两条 adapter 路径上都归为 `TRANSPORT`，落入默认可重试码，`llm-retry` 以标准有界指数退避自动重试（5 次，500 ms→10 s）。既有 `llm/retry` 事件消费者（TUI）无需任何改动即可展示重试。

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

## Problem

Behind OpenAI-compatible gateways (e.g. OpenCode Zen), a turn fails outright with:

```
Provider finish_reason: network_error
```

The gateway reports its own transient upstream connection failure as the stream's `finish_reason`; retrying immediately usually succeeds (same class of reports as anomalyco/opencode#41236). dsh classifies this failure as non-retryable, so the whole turn hard-fails instead of retrying — in one real session the subagent channel hit this string 8 times in a row.

## Root cause

Two adapters turn the wire `finish_reason` into an error code, and both miss the network variant:

1. **llm-pi-ai** — pi-ai 0.82 maps an unknown `finish_reason` to `stopReason: 'error'` with `errorMessage: 'Provider finish_reason: network_error'` (`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `api/openai-completions.js`, `mapStopReason`). `classifyPiAiError` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`) then tests `/\b(?:network|connection|socket|fetch)\b/` — but `\b` does not hold between `k` and `_` (underscore is a word character), so `network_error` falls through to `PI_AI_ERROR`, which `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` does not include. `llm-retry` passes the failure through and the turn fails.
2. **llm-deepseek** — `mapFinishReason` (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`) uppercases unknown reasons into the failure code: `network_error` → `NETWORK_ERROR`, also not in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`.

## Reference

opencode hit and fixed the same gateway behavior on 2026-08-21:

- anomalyco/opencode@40282c1 — widen the retryable regex from `network error` to `network[-_\s]error`, covering the hyphen/underscore variants.
- anomalyco/opencode@e0b9e68 — fail the finish-step event when `rawFinishReason === "network_error"` so the existing retry pipeline handles it (test asserts the 2nd attempt succeeds).

## Fix (prepared, tested)

Since the repository does not accept external PRs at the moment, the fix is prepared and fully tested on a fork branch:

https://github.com/fan56/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/network-error-retryable

- `llm-pi-ai`: `classifyPiAiError` gains an explicit `/network[-_ ]error/i` arm ahead of the existing alternation, classifying all three spellings as `TRANSPORT`. The existing matches (AUTH/quota/429/4xx/5xx/timeout/stream-truncation/ECONN*/terminated/premature close) are untouched.
- `llm-deepseek`: `mapFinishReason` maps `network_error`/`network-error` to `{kind:'error', failure:{message:'model stopped: <reason>', code:'TRANSPORT'}}`.

`TRANSPORT` is already in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`, so no retry-policy change is needed.

Tests: transport-wording table extended in `llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts`; `mapFinishReason` cases in `llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts`. `vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai packages/llm/llm-deepseek` → 608 passed; `pnpm run typecheck` → clean. Happy to rebase/adjust if the team wants to land it.

## Workaround plugin for released versions

A plugin for users on released versions (retries these failures at the end of the `agent/request-error` waterfall, only when every downstream listener declined):

https://github.com/fan56/dsh-llm-net-retry — also on npm as `@aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry@0.1.0` (`dsh plugin --profile tui add @aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry`).

Its e2e drives the real agent loop + `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter against a scripted gateway failing the first two requests with `finish_reason: network_error` and asserts the turn completes on the third. The plugin stays harmless once the base fix lands: it only acts when the whole waterfall declined and never touches llm-retry's own counting. Now also validated on a real dsh 0.1.0-rc.8 TUI host — see the update comment below.

## Result

With the fix, a gateway `network_error` classifies as `TRANSPORT` on both adapter paths, falls inside the default retryable codes, and `llm-retry` retries it with the standard bounded exponential backoff (5 attempts, 500 ms→10 s). Existing `llm/retry` event consumers (TUI) surface the retries with no changes.

</details>

comments.body:
**更新——已在真实 dsh 宿主（TUI）上验证**

上面的过渡插件已在真实 `dsh --profile tui` 启动（dsh 0.1.0-rc.8）中完成端到端验证：

- **环境**：插件通过 `dsh plugin --profile tui add …` 装入 tui profile；默认模型经 `--patch` 覆盖 + 临时 settings 文件指向脚本化的本地 OpenAI 兼容网关（真实 settings 文档零触碰）。网关前两次请求回 `finish_reason: "network_error"`，之后回普通文本。
- **观察**：默认 policy 对这个被误分类的失败弃权，插件调度有界重试，turn 在第三次请求完成、网关文本渲染在 TUI 中。持久化 session 日志在插件自己的 policy key 下记录了完整链条——`llm/retry` retry 1（延迟 ≈524 ms）→ `llm/retry-started` → `llm/retry` retry 2（延迟 ≈1056 ms）→ `llm/retry-started` → 成功：指数退避 + 对称抖动，整条链共用一个 retryId。
- TUI 零改动：它本来就渲染 `llm/retry` 事件，这些重试与原生 `dsh-llm-retry` 的重试展示完全一致。

仓库还带完整自动化套件：单测（匹配表、注入随机数的退避计算、配置校验、真实 cordis context 上的决策链）+ agent-loop e2e（真实 `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter 打同样的脚本化网关），并有负向对照证明无插件时一次请求后 turn 即硬失败。

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

**Update — validated on a real dsh host (TUI)**

The workaround plugin above is now verified end-to-end on a live `dsh --profile tui` boot (dsh 0.1.0-rc.8):

- **Setup**: the plugin was installed into the tui profile with `dsh plugin --profile tui add …`, and the default model was routed to a scripted local OpenAI-compatible gateway through a `--patch` overlay plus a temporary settings file (the real settings document untouched). The gateway answers the first two requests with `finish_reason: "network_error"` and every later one with plain text.
- **Observed**: the stock policy declined the misclassified failure, the plugin scheduled its bounded retry, and the turn completed on the third request with the gateway's text rendered in the TUI. The durable session log shows the full chain under the plugin's own policy key — `llm/retry` retry 1 (delay ≈524 ms) → `llm/retry-started` → `llm/retry` retry 2 (delay ≈1056 ms) → `llm/retry-started` → success: exponential backoff with symmetric jitter and one stable retryId across the chain.
- The TUI needed no changes: it already renders `llm/retry` events, so these retries surface exactly like stock `dsh-llm-retry` retries.

The repo also carries the automated suite: unit tests (matcher table, backoff math with injected randomness, config validation, and the decision chain on a real cordis context with a real session store) plus an agent-loop e2e that drives the real `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter against the same scripted gateway behavior, with a negative control proving the turn hard-fails after a single request without the plugin.

</details>

records.title: Provider model catalogs are stale for OpenCode Go and OpenRouter
records.body:
Tested with `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2` and the Open Design profile on Linux. The active DSH catalog exposed 16 OpenCode Go models while the authenticated provider `/models` endpoint returned 29. OpenRouter exposed 276 while its public `/models` endpoint returned 420; the static catalog also retained 11 IDs no longer returned live. Updating the nested compatible `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency from 0.82.1 to 0.84.2 improved this only partially (19 and 346 respectively).

The root behavior appears intentional but surprising: `dsh-llm-pi-ai` documents `registerModelDiscovery` as UI-only candidate discovery, not an active catalog refresh, so routes with omitted `models` remain pinned to the installed pi-ai snapshot.

A validated local workaround is to materialize the live IDs into each provider profile and explicitly state transport metadata so unknown-to-catalog IDs resolve:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode-go:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
    openrouter:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
```

After applying the exact live snapshots, `dsh --profile open-design --models` reports 29/29 OpenCode Go and 420/420 OpenRouter IDs, including `gpt-5.6-luna`, `qwen3.8-max`, `muse-spark-1.2-contributor`, `google/gemini-3.7-flash`, `stealth/ox-alpha`, and `z-ai/glm-5.3`.

Could DSH offer an opt-in live-catalog policy (with timeout/cache/stale fallback), or a supported refresh/adopt command, for OpenAI-compatible routes? That would retain configuration as the source of truth while avoiding silent catalog drift.

records.title: headless run with an openai-codex OAuth route lingers 5 minutes after completion (pi-ai session WebSocket cache is never cleaned up)
records.body:
### Summary

A headless `dsh --profile headless "<prompt>"` run whose turn uses an **openai-codex OAuth route** does not exit when the turn completes. The final answer and the `completed` log are durable immediately, but the process stays alive for exactly **five more minutes**, then exits normally.

### Root cause (verified on stock npm packages)

`@earendil-works/pi-ai` (0.82.1, as resolved by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai@0.1.1-rc.2`) keeps the Codex **session WebSocket cached** for reuse when a `sessionId` is supplied:

- `dist/api/openai-codex-responses.js` — after a completed request, `processWebSocketStream → release({ keep: true }) → scheduleSessionWebSocketExpiry(sessionId, entry)`.
- The idle timer is `SESSION_WEBSOCKET_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000`, created with plain `setTimeout` (not `unref`ed), and the cached WebSocket itself is also a referenced handle — so the Node event loop cannot drain.
- `dsh-llm-pi-ai` forwards the DSH `sessionId` into pi-ai (enabling this cache), but nothing calls pi-ai's provided cleanup — `cleanupSessionResources(sessionId?)` from `dist/session-resources.js` — when the headless session/agent finishes. We found no caller of `cleanupSessionResources` anywhere in the `@deepseek-ai/*` tree.

### Isolation evidence

| Scenario | Exit |
|---|---|
| headless turn on a DeepSeek route | ~3 s |
| same + an installed plugin that creates a child agent (DeepSeek) | ~6 s |
| any headless turn using the openai-codex OAuth route | **~5 min** (exits when the idle TTL closes the socket) |

The 5-minute wait reproduces with unrelated plugin sets, and disappears whenever the Codex OAuth route is not used — it tracks the provider, not any plugin.

### Suggested fix

Have `dsh-llm-pi-ai` call `cleanupSessionResources(sessionId)` when a session/agent is disposed (or at least when a headless run finishes its last turn). `unref`ing the timer alone would not be enough — the cached WebSocket is a referenced handle too.

Happy to provide the full reproduction runs if useful.

comments.body:
I implemented and verified a reference fix for this report:

- Reference commit: https://github.com/Jstn-1g/deepseek-harness/commit/d3edd5f1ee8e31325f6de54dbac67acb0d461872
- Reference branch: https://github.com/Jstn-1g/deepseek-harness/tree/reference/discussion-4190-agent-session-resources

The adapter now claims pi-ai's session-keyed resources at actual stream use and installs one exact-ID cleanup in the live Agent's own scope. This preserves Codex WebSocket reuse while the Agent is live; then AgentLoop quiesces model work before scope teardown synchronously clears the five-minute idle timer and closes the cached socket. The Agent-scope owner survives concurrent llm-pi-ai listener unload during whole-runtime shutdown. Same-ID replacement is keyed by the Agent object. A quiesced direct Session caller retains an explicit `session/disposed` fallback. There is deliberately no process-global cleanup on plugin unload because pi-ai's registry/cache are module-global.

The deterministic account-free regression first reproduced the whole-runtime shutdown leak, then passed with the fix. Validation passed: 268/268 llm-pi-ai tests, 100% statements/branches/functions/lines for the changed `index.ts`, full typecheck, doc-sync 28/28, workspace constraints, lint, translation pairing, generated graph, diff integrity, and the pre-push host build/typecheck.
